# B2BNest

> B2BNest is a SaaS business software platform for entrepreneurs and small businesses: 25+ business tools in one place, including CRM, projects and tasks, invoicing, expenses, HMRC-connected finance tools, AI document generation and an AI business advisor.

B2BNest replaces several separate subscriptions with one workspace that supports multiple companies per account. Free utilities (QR code generator, currency converter, business name generator and more) are available without a paid plan.

## Pricing (GBP)

- Starter: £19/month or £190/year — 1 user, 250 AI credits/month
- Professional: £35/month or £350/year — 5 users, 1,000 AI credits/month
- Enterprise: £85/month or £850/year — 25 users, 5,000 AI credits/month
